notes.title: How to fix square texts!!! (This is important)
notes.notes:
This is Dieselmine

Players, sorry for making this inconvenience.

The game is defaulted launch in the Chinese language, that makes all the text become squares.

The way to fix it is,
First, select the third option, and you will see two option coming up.
second, select the first option, that will change the language into English.

Dieselmine
2017/12/06

notes.title: 1.10 Update
notes.notes:
◆Bug fix
・Fix the bug of can not unlock the full CG mode
・Fix the bug of can not get Princess Serena's best sword
・Fix the bug of can not wear Meia's pirate clothes
・Fix the bug of Bathroom scenario
・Fix the bug of description and text problem
・Fix the problem of text getting over the text window

◆About Game frame rate and laging problem
We have received the problems of low game frame rate and lagging problem.
Reinstall the game or plug in a game controller should fix the problem.
（※Please notes that Game does not support controller)

Dieselmine
